---
title: "2)16S"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(ape)
library(decontam)
library(picante)
library(vegan)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(biomformat)
library(broom)

set.seed(123)
```


```{r}

# 1) Import


metadata_16S <- import_qiime_sample_data(
  "Dataset_16S_EmysOrbicularis_Meyer"
)

micro_biom_16S <- import_biom(
  "16S_Taxonomy.biom"
)

tree_16S <- read_tree_greengenes(
  "16SRootedTreeEmys.tree"
)

ps_16S <- merge_phyloseq(metadata_16S, micro_biom_16S, tree_16S)

ps_16S
```

```{r}

# 2) Basic cleanup


if (!is.null(tax_table(ps_16S, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) {
  if (ncol(tax_table(ps_16S)) == 7) {
    colnames(tax_table(ps_16S)) <- c(
      "Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"
    )
  }
}

taxa_names(ps_16S) <- paste0("ASV_", seq_len(ntaxa(ps_16S)))

cat("Initial dataset:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_16S), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_16S), "\n")

sample_sums_df <- data.frame(seq_depth = sample_sums(ps_16S))

summary(sample_sums_df$seq_depth)

ggplot(sample_sums_df, aes(x = seq_depth)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "grey70", colour = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Initial sequencing depth",
    x = "Read counts",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```

```{r}

# 3) Remove non-bacterial / unwanted taxa


ps_16S_clean <- subset_taxa(
  ps_16S,
  (is.na(Domain) | Domain == "D_0__Bacteria" | Domain == "Bacteria") &
    (is.na(Family) | !grepl("Mitochondria", Family, ignore.case = TRUE)) &
    (is.na(Class)  | !grepl("Chloroplast",  Class,  ignore.case = TRUE)) &
    (is.na(Order)  | !grepl("Chloroplast",  Order,  ignore.case = TRUE))
)

cat("After taxonomy cleaning:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_16S_clean), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_16S_clean), "\n")
```

```{r}

# 4) Define negative controls for decontam


sample_data(ps_16S_clean)$control_status <- factor(
  sample_data(ps_16S_clean)$sample_type %in% c("PCR_blank", "ex_blank"),
  levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  labels = c("sample", "control")
)

sample_data(ps_16S_clean)$is_neg <- sample_data(ps_16S_clean)$control_status == "control"

table(sample_data(ps_16S_clean)$control_status, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}

# 5) Decontam (prevalence method)


if (sum(sample_data(ps_16S_clean)$is_neg, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  
  contam_prev <- isContaminant(
    ps_16S_clean,
    method = "prevalence",
    neg = "is_neg",
    threshold = 0.1
  )
  
  cat("Contaminants identified:\n")
  print(table(contam_prev$contaminant))
  
  ps_16S_noncontam <- prune_taxa(!contam_prev$contaminant, ps_16S_clean)
  
} else {
  warning("No negative controls detected for decontam; continuing without contaminant filtering.")
  ps_16S_noncontam <- ps_16S_clean
}

cat("After decontam:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_16S_noncontam), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_16S_noncontam), "\n")
```

```{r}

# 6) Restrict to nest vs control samples


ps_2024_nc <- subset_samples(
  ps_16S_noncontam,
  sample_type %in% c("nest", "control")
)

ps_2024_nc <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_2024_nc) > 0, ps_2024_nc)

sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$sample_type <- trimws(as.character(sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$sample_type))
sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$sample_type <- tolower(sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$sample_type)
sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$sample_type <- factor(
  sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$sample_type,
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

cat("Nest/control subset:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_2024_nc), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_2024_nc), "\n")
print(table(sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$sample_type))
print(table(sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$nesting_site))
```

```{r}

# 7) Sequencing depth QC and filtering


sample_data(ps_2024_nc)$Seq_depth <- sample_sums(ps_2024_nc)

depth_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_2024_nc))

ggplot(depth_df, aes(x = Seq_depth, fill = sample_type)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, colour = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_type, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Sequencing depth by sample type",
    x = "Read counts",
    y = "Frequency"
  )

summary(sample_sums(ps_2024_nc))

min_depth <- 5000

ps_final <- subset_samples(ps_2024_nc, sample_sums(ps_2024_nc) >= min_depth)
ps_final <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_final) > 0, ps_final)

sample_data(ps_final)$sample_type <- factor(
  tolower(trimws(as.character(sample_data(ps_final)$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

cat("After depth filtering (>= ", min_depth, " reads):\n", sep = "")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_final), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_final), "\n")

depths <- sample_sums(ps_final)
cat(
  "Final 16S dataset contains", nsamples(ps_final),
  "samples with mean sequencing depth of", round(mean(depths)),
  "reads (±", round(sd(depths)), "SD; range:", min(depths), "-", max(depths), ").\n"
)
```

```{r}

# 8) Plot style

pal_main <- c(
  "control" = "#053B45",
  "nest"    = "#B8AA50"
)

pal_accent <- c(
  "petrol" = "#053B45",
  "olive"  = "#B8AA50",
  "wine"   = "#843447",
  "cream"  = "#FBFAF5",
  "grey"   = "grey65"
)

theme_pub <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 17, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
```


```{r}

# 9) Alpha diversity


alpha_est <- estimate_richness(
  ps_final,
  measures = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon")
)

alpha_est$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_final)

otu_mat_alpha <- as(otu_table(ps_final), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_final)) {
  otu_mat_alpha <- t(otu_mat_alpha)
}

faith_pd <- pd(otu_mat_alpha, phy_tree(ps_final), include.root = TRUE)

faith_pd_df <- data.frame(
  sample_name = rownames(faith_pd),
  Faith_PD = faith_pd$PD,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta_alpha <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta_alpha$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_final)

alpha_df <- alpha_est %>%
  left_join(meta_alpha, by = "sample_name") %>%
  left_join(faith_pd_df, by = "sample_name")

alpha_df$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(alpha_df$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

dplyr::count(alpha_df, sample_type)

alpha_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    Observed_median = median(Observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    Chao1_median = median(Chao1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Shannon_median = median(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    FaithPD_median = median(Faith_PD, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}

# 10) Alpha diversity statistics
# site-adjusted main models


alpha_metrics <- c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Faith_PD")

table(alpha_df$nesting_site, alpha_df$sample_type)
length(unique(alpha_df$nesting_site))

alpha_results <- purrr::map_dfr(alpha_metrics, function(v) {
  
  dat_sub <- alpha_df %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_type, nesting_site, dplyr::all_of(v)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  
  fit <- lm(
    as.formula(paste0("log1p(", v, ") ~ sample_type + nesting_site")),
    data = dat_sub
  )
  
  broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "sample_typenest") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      metric = v,
      median_control = median(dat_sub[[v]][dat_sub$sample_type == "control"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nest = median(dat_sub[[v]][dat_sub$sample_type == "nest"], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
})

alpha_results <- alpha_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ "higher_in_nest",
      estimate < 0 ~ "lower_in_nest",
      TRUE ~ "no_difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.value)

alpha_results
```

```{r}

# 11) Alpha diversity plots
# BH-adjusted significance stars


get_alpha_star <- function(metric_name) {
  
  this_p <- alpha_results %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    pull(p_adj_bh)
  
  if (length(this_p) == 0) return("")
  
  p_to_stars(this_p[1])
}

plot_alpha_metric <- function(dat, metric, ylab_text, title_text = metric) {
  
  this_star <- get_alpha_star(metric)
  
  y_max <- max(dat[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(dat[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  
  if (is.na(y_range) || y_range == 0) {
    y_pos <- y_max * 1.08
  } else {
    y_pos <- y_max + 0.08 * y_range
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = sample_type, y = .data[[metric]], colour = sample_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = sample_type),
      width = 0.52,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab_text
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11)
    )
  
  if (this_star != "") {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1.5,
        y = y_pos,
        label = this_star,
        size = 6,
        fontface = "bold"
      )
  }
  
  p
}

p_obs   <- plot_alpha_metric(alpha_df, "Observed", "Observed richness", "Observed")
p_chao1 <- plot_alpha_metric(alpha_df, "Chao1", "Chao1 richness", "Chao1")
p_shan  <- plot_alpha_metric(alpha_df, "Shannon", "Shannon diversity", "Shannon")
p_faith <- plot_alpha_metric(alpha_df, "Faith_PD", "Faith's PD", "Faith's PD")

p_alpha <- p_obs + p_chao1 + p_shan + p_faith +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2)

p_alpha


```

```{r}

# 12) Rarefaction for beta diversity


set.seed(123)

rarefaction_depth <- 6000

ps_beta_ra <- rarefy_even_depth(
  ps_final,
  sample.size = rarefaction_depth,
  rngseed = 123,
  replace = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

print(summary(sample_sums(ps_beta_ra)))
```

```{r}

# 13) Metadata for beta analyses


meta_beta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_beta_ra), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta_beta$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_beta_ra)

meta_beta$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(meta_beta$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

table(meta_beta$sample_type, useNA = "ifany")
table(meta_beta$nesting_site, meta_beta$sample_type)


# 14) Distance matrices


dist_jacc <- phyloseq::distance(ps_beta_ra, method = "jaccard")
dist_uni  <- phyloseq::distance(ps_beta_ra, method = "unifrac")
dist_wuni <- phyloseq::distance(ps_beta_ra, method = "wunifrac")
dist_bray <- phyloseq::distance(ps_beta_ra, method = "bray")


# 15) Ordinations


ord_jacc <- ordinate(ps_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_jacc)
ord_uni  <- ordinate(ps_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_uni)
ord_wuni <- ordinate(ps_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_wuni)
ord_bray <- ordinate(ps_beta_ra, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_bray)



# 16) Beta diversity statistics
# main models: nesting_site + sample_type


adonis_jacc <- adonis2(
  dist_jacc ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_uni <- adonis2(
  dist_uni ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_wuni <- adonis2(
  dist_wuni ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_bray <- adonis2(
  dist_bray ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

disp_jacc <- betadisper(dist_jacc, group = meta_beta$sample_type)
disp_uni  <- betadisper(dist_uni,  group = meta_beta$sample_type)
disp_wuni <- betadisper(dist_wuni, group = meta_beta$sample_type)
disp_bray <- betadisper(dist_bray, group = meta_beta$sample_type)

disp_jacc_test <- permutest(disp_jacc, permutations = 999)
disp_uni_test  <- permutest(disp_uni,  permutations = 999)
disp_wuni_test <- permutest(disp_wuni, permutations = 999)
disp_bray_test <- permutest(disp_bray, permutations = 999)

adonis_jacc
adonis_uni
adonis_wuni
adonis_bray

disp_jacc_test
disp_uni_test
disp_wuni_test
disp_bray_test

```

```{r}

# 17) Beta diversity plots
# styled like nutrient PCA plots


extract_scores <- function(ord_obj, meta_df) {
  scr <- as.data.frame(ord_obj$vectors[, 1:2])
  scr <- tibble::rownames_to_column(scr, "sample_name")
  colnames(scr)[2:3] <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
  
  scr %>%
    left_join(meta_df, by = "sample_name")
}

get_axis_percent <- function(ord_obj, axis = 1) {
  vals <- ord_obj$values$Relative_eig
  if (!is.null(vals)) {
    round(100 * vals[axis], 1)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}

scores_jacc <- extract_scores(ord_jacc, meta_beta)
scores_uni  <- extract_scores(ord_uni,  meta_beta)
scores_wuni <- extract_scores(ord_wuni, meta_beta)
scores_bray <- extract_scores(ord_bray, meta_beta)

plot_beta_pub <- function(score_df, ord_obj, title_text) {
  
  var1 <- get_axis_percent(ord_obj, 1)
  var2 <- get_axis_percent(ord_obj, 2)
  
  ggplot(score_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var1, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var2, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

p_jacc <- plot_beta_pub(scores_jacc, ord_jacc, "Jaccard")
p_uni  <- plot_beta_pub(scores_uni,  ord_uni,  "Unweighted UniFrac")
p_wuni <- plot_beta_pub(scores_wuni, ord_wuni, "Weighted UniFrac")
p_bray <- plot_beta_pub(scores_bray, ord_bray, "Bray-Curtis")

p_beta <- p_jacc + p_uni + p_wuni + p_bray + plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

p_beta


```

```{r}

# 17B) Compositional beta diversity: Aitchison / CLR
# non-rarefied data, site-adjusted


library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)


# 1) Metadata from ps_final (non-rarefied)

meta_clr <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta_clr$sample_name <- sample_names(ps_final)

meta_clr$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(meta_clr$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

meta_clr$nesting_site <- factor(meta_clr$nesting_site)


# 2) Extract count matrix

otu_clr <- as(otu_table(ps_final), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_final)) {
  otu_clr <- t(otu_clr)
}

# remove zero-sum taxa just in case
otu_clr <- otu_clr[, colSums(otu_clr) > 0, drop = FALSE]


# 3) CLR transform with pseudocount

# Aitchison distance = Euclidean distance on CLR-transformed data
# pseudocount is needed because of zeros
pseudocount <- 1

otu_clr_pc <- otu_clr + pseudocount

clr_transform <- function(x) {
  log_x <- log(x)
  log_x - mean(log_x)
}

otu_clr_mat <- t(apply(otu_clr_pc, 1, clr_transform))


# 4) Aitchison distance + PCA

dist_aitch <- dist(otu_clr_mat, method = "euclidean")

pca_aitch <- prcomp(otu_clr_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

scores_aitch <- as.data.frame(pca_aitch$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_name") %>%
  left_join(meta_clr, by = "sample_name")

var_expl_aitch <- summary(pca_aitch)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100


# 5) Statistics

adonis_aitch <- adonis2(
  dist_aitch ~ nesting_site + sample_type,
  data = meta_clr,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

disp_aitch <- betadisper(dist_aitch, group = meta_clr$sample_type)
disp_aitch_test <- permutest(disp_aitch, permutations = 999)

# blocked permutation within nesting site
adonis_aitch_block <- {
  perm_block <- how(nperm = 999)
  setBlocks(perm_block) <- meta_clr$nesting_site
  adonis2(
    dist_aitch ~ sample_type,
    data = meta_clr,
    permutations = perm_block
  )
}

adonis_aitch
disp_aitch_test
adonis_aitch_block


# 6) Plot

p_aitch <- ggplot(scores_aitch, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(colour = sample_type),
    geom = "path",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    type = "norm"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = sample_type),
    size = 5.2,
    alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
  labs(
    title = "Aitchison beta diversity",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_expl_aitch[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_expl_aitch[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

p_aitch


# 7) Export result table

aitch_table_out <- tibble(
  distance = "Aitchison_CLR",
  site_r2 = adonis_aitch$R2[1],
  site_f = adonis_aitch$F[1],
  site_p = adonis_aitch$`Pr(>F)`[1],
  sample_type_r2 = adonis_aitch$R2[2],
  sample_type_f = adonis_aitch$F[2],
  sample_type_p = adonis_aitch$`Pr(>F)`[2],
  dispersion_f = disp_aitch_test$tab[1, "F"],
  dispersion_p = disp_aitch_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
  blocked_sample_type_r2 = adonis_aitch_block$R2[1],
  blocked_sample_type_f = adonis_aitch_block$F[1],
  blocked_sample_type_p = adonis_aitch_block$`Pr(>F)`[1]
)

aitch_table_out

write_csv(
  aitch_table_out,
  "Table_16S_beta_aitchison_2024.csv"
)
```

```{r}
    adonis_jacc$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    adonis_uni$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    adonis_wuni$`Pr(>F)`[2],
    adonis_bray$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  ),
  dispersion_f = c(
    disp_jacc_test$tab[1, "F"],
    disp_uni_test$tab[1, "F"],
    disp_wuni_test$tab[1, "F"],
    disp_bray_test$tab[1, "F"]
  ),
  dispersion_p = c(
    disp_jacc_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
    disp_uni_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
    disp_wuni_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
    disp_bray_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"]
  )
)

beta_table_out

write_csv(
  beta_table_out,
  "Table_16S_beta_site_and_sampletype_2024.csv"
)
```

```{r}

# 19) Sensitivity analyses for nesting_site
# Bray-Curtis example


adonis_site_only <- adonis2(
  dist_bray ~ nesting_site,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999
)

adonis_sample_only <- adonis2(
  dist_bray ~ sample_type,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999
)

adonis_bray_block <- {
  perm_block <- how(nperm = 999)
  setBlocks(perm_block) <- meta_beta$nesting_site
  adonis2(
    dist_bray ~ sample_type,
    data = meta_beta,
    permutations = perm_block
  )
}

adonis_site_only
adonis_sample_only
adonis_bray_block
adonis_bray
```

```{r}
# Shared settings for 16S and ITS differential abundance plots


sig_levels_DA <- c(
  "Robust after BH correction",
  "BH-corrected only",
  "Nominal only"
)

sig_cols_DA <- c(
  "Robust after BH correction" = "#EE2F5C",
  "BH-corrected only"          = "#5F2D85",
  "Nominal only"               = "#D5BBC4"
)
```


```{r}

# 16S Differential abundance analysis: ANCOM-BC2 genus level
# Nest vs control, adjusted for nesting site
# Run on NON-rarefied data: ps_final


library(phyloseq)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

set.seed(123)


# 1) Prepare 16S genus-level phyloseq object


ps_genus_16S <- tax_glom(ps_final, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

sample_data(ps_genus_16S)$sample_type <- factor(
  trimws(tolower(as.character(sample_data(ps_genus_16S)$sample_type))),
  levels = c("control", "nest")
)

sample_data(ps_genus_16S)$nesting_site <- factor(sample_data(ps_genus_16S)$nesting_site)

cat("Genus-level 16S dataset:\n")
cat("Samples:", nsamples(ps_genus_16S), "\n")
cat("Taxa:", ntaxa(ps_genus_16S), "\n")


# 2) Run conservative ANCOM-BC2


out_ancom2_genus_16S <- ancombc2(
  data = ps_genus_16S,
  tax_level = "Genus",
  assay_name = "counts",
  fix_formula = "sample_type + nesting_site",
  rand_formula = NULL,
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  lib_cut = 1000,
  s0_perc = 0.05,
  group = "sample_type",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  n_cl = 1,
  verbose = TRUE,
  global = FALSE,
  pairwise = FALSE,
  dunnet = FALSE,
  trend = FALSE
)


# 3) Clean and classify 16S ANCOM-BC2 results


res_genus_16S <- out_ancom2_genus_16S$res %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    genus = taxon,
    genus = str_remove(genus, "^D_5__"),
    genus = str_trim(genus),
    
    clean_genus = !str_detect(
      genus,
      regex(
        "D_0__|D_1__|D_2__|D_3__|D_4__|D_5__|uncultured|unidentified|metagenome|Ambiguous_taxa|ASV_|microorganism|PCC-",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    ),
    
    enrichment = case_when(
      lfc_sample_typenest > 0 ~ "enriched_in_nest",
      lfc_sample_typenest < 0 ~ "enriched_in_control",
      TRUE ~ "no_change"
    ),
    
    significance = case_when(
      q_sample_typenest < 0.05 & diff_robust_sample_typenest == TRUE  ~ "Robust after BH correction",
      q_sample_typenest < 0.05 & diff_robust_sample_typenest == FALSE ~ "BH-corrected only",
      TRUE ~ "Nominal only"
    ),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = sig_levels_DA)
  )

# 4) Export 16S result tables


ancom_table_all_16S <- res_genus_16S %>%
  select(
    taxon,
    genus,
    clean_genus,
    lfc_sample_typenest,
    se_sample_typenest,
    W_sample_typenest,
    p_sample_typenest,
    q_sample_typenest,
    passed_ss_sample_typenest,
    diff_sample_typenest,
    diff_robust_sample_typenest,
    significance,
    enrichment
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_sample_typenest, p_sample_typenest)

ancom_table_robust_16S <- ancom_table_all_16S %>%
  filter(
    q_sample_typenest < 0.05,
    diff_robust_sample_typenest == TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_sample_typenest, desc(lfc_sample_typenest))

ancom_table_nominal_clean_16S <- ancom_table_all_16S %>%
  filter(
    p_sample_typenest < 0.05,
    clean_genus
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_sample_typenest, desc(lfc_sample_typenest))

final_ancom_table_16S <- ancom_table_robust_16S %>%
  transmute(
    genus,
    log_fold_change = round(lfc_sample_typenest, 2),
    se = round(se_sample_typenest, 2),
    W = round(W_sample_typenest, 2),
    p_value = signif(p_sample_typenest, 3),
    q_value = signif(q_sample_typenest, 3),
    significance,
    enrichment
  )

write_csv(ancom_table_all_16S, "Table_16S_ANCOMBC2_genus_all_cleaned.csv")
write_csv(ancom_table_robust_16S, "Table_16S_ANCOMBC2_genus_robust_BH.csv")
write_csv(ancom_table_nominal_clean_16S, "Table_16S_ANCOMBC2_genus_nominal_clean_for_plot.csv")
write_csv(final_ancom_table_16S, "Table_16S_ANCOMBC2_genus_final_for_paper.csv")

cat("\nRobust BH-significant bacterial genera:\n")
print(
  ancom_table_robust_16S %>%
    select(genus, lfc_sample_typenest, p_sample_typenest, q_sample_typenest, enrichment),
  n = Inf
)

cat("\nClean nominal p < 0.05 bacterial genera for plot:\n")
print(
  ancom_table_nominal_clean_16S %>%
    select(genus, lfc_sample_typenest, p_sample_typenest, q_sample_typenest, significance, enrichment),
  n = Inf
)


# 5) Build 16S forest plot dataframe-


plot_da_df_16S <- res_genus_16S %>%
  filter(
    p_sample_typenest < 0.05,
    clean_genus
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_low = lfc_sample_typenest - 1.96 * se_sample_typenest,
    ci_high = lfc_sample_typenest + 1.96 * se_sample_typenest
  ) %>%
  arrange(lfc_sample_typenest) %>%
  mutate(
    genus = factor(genus, levels = genus),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = sig_levels_DA)
  )

# Check what appears in the 16S plot
plot_da_df_16S %>%
  mutate(genus = as.character(genus)) %>%
  select(
    genus,
    lfc_sample_typenest,
    se_sample_typenest,
    p_sample_typenest,
    q_sample_typenest,
    diff_robust_sample_typenest,
    significance,
    enrichment
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# 6) 16S forest plot


p_da_forest_16S <- ggplot(
  plot_da_df_16S,
  aes(x = lfc_sample_typenest, y = genus)
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.14,
    linewidth = 1.0,
    colour = "grey55",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = significance),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5.2,
    colour = "grey35",
    stroke = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  name = "Differential abundance evidence",
  values = sig_cols_DA,
  breaks = sig_levels_DA,
  limits = sig_levels_DA,
  drop = FALSE,
  guide = "none"
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Differentially abundant bacterial genera",
    x = "Log fold change (nest vs control)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")
  ) 

p_da_forest_16S

# 7) output for ecological interpretation

plot_da_df %>%
  mutate(genus = as.character(genus)) %>%
  select(
    genus,
    lfc_sample_typenest,
    p_sample_typenest,
    q_sample_typenest,
    significance,
    enrichment
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(lfc_sample_typenest)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

###########

# Supplementary Figure 3
# alpha diversity (top row) + beta diversity (bottom row)


# 1) Alpha plots


p_obs2 <- p_obs +
  labs(y = "Bacterial diversity") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

p_chao12 <- p_chao1 +

p_faith2 <- p_faith +

# 2) Beta plots


p_jacc2 <- p_jacc +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

p_uni2 <- p_uni +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

p_wuni2 <- p_wuni +

# Alpha:

# Beta:

p_supp3 <- p_alpha_row / p_beta_row +

p_supp3
```
